name: odin-pr-review-workspace
description: Graph visualization of pull request changes

scripts.build: tsc --build packages/core && yarn workspace @odin/webview run build:app && tsc --build && yarn workspace odin-pr-review run build && yarn workspace @odin/browser-ext run build
scripts.typecheck: tsc --build packages/core && yarn workspace @odin/webview run build:app && tsc --build --force && yarn workspace @odin/browser-ext run typecheck
scripts.build:libs: tsc --build packages/core && yarn workspace @odin/webview run build:app && tsc --build
scripts.package: yarn build && yarn workspace odin-pr-review run package
